OVERVIEW
The Unmanaged Media Converter provides conversion between 10/100/1000Base-T and 100/1000Base-X. It is an ideal solution
to extend the distance of an existing network, the distance of non-fiber based equipment, or the distance between two devices.
The Unmanaged 1G Ethernet Media Converter is equipped with one 10/100/1000M BASE-T auto-negotiation port and one
100/1000M BASE-X SFP+ slot. It is designed for use in network environments where the high bandwidth provided by 1Gigabit
Ethernet is required, for example, data center cloud computing, enterprise backbones, campus networks, and carrier infrastructure.
